Context: 5. Reinstatement

3. in Court proceedings and no further departmental inquiry is held.
- (3) On reinstatement when suspension is held to be wholly unjustified.
- (4) When minor penalty is awarded.
6. If detention in police custody, erroneous or without basis, ends in release without prosecution and if the Competent Authority concludes that
- (5) suspension was wholly unjustified.
- (6) If the detention under a law providing for preventive detention is
9. held by the Competent Authority to be unjustified.
